Fox and Endemol Shine to Adapt 'Fear Factor' into Scripted Mobile Horror Series

A New Direction for a Reality Classic

Fox Entertainment Studios and Endemol Shine North America have announced a strategic expansion of the long-running 'Fear Factor' franchise. Moving away from its traditional unscripted format, the brand will launch an original, scripted horror series designed specifically for mobile, vertical-screen consumption. The project will be hosted on the 'My Drama' platform, operated by Holywater Tech.

Narrative Premise and Format

The untitled series will consist of 30 short-form episodes, each three minutes in length. According to project details, the plot centers on a film crew working on a remote horror television set. The story follows a practical-effects artist and her colleagues who inadvertently trigger a haunted fortune-telling device, trapping them in a series of personalized 'death trials' that mirror the tension and high-stakes environment associated with the original reality show.

Industry Context and Mobile-First Strategy

This project represents the first instance of an established unscripted television franchise transitioning into original scripted storytelling. The move aligns with the industry's growing focus on vertical, mobile-first entertainment. Executives from both Fox and Endemol Shine noted that the immediacy and intimacy of vertical storytelling provide a unique medium for horror, effectively leveraging the constraints of the mobile screen to enhance the viewer's experience.

Production and Franchise Performance

This scripted development follows the success of 'Fear Factor: House of Fear,' hosted by Johnny Knoxville, which was recently renewed for a second season. Fox reports that the unscripted 'House of Fear' series garnered 17.5 million multiplatform viewers, establishing itself as a top-rated broadcast debut. The upcoming scripted series is written by Thom Woodley and Andrew Beck, directed by Gabriel Caste, and produced by Ian Nsenga and Yuliia Vyshnevska. While the series launch date is currently pending, worldwide distribution will be managed by Fox Entertainment Global.

How to Verify

Interested readers can track updates regarding the production and future premiere dates through official announcements from Fox Entertainment and the My Drama platform.
